name: Collapsing Ramp (7-8)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination

disable: DC 28 Crafting check (expert) to stabilize the masonry. Each attempt takes 2 actions.

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks onto the collapse site

---

Effect The triggering creature falls off the Colossus and lands on the ground, taking 40 bludgeoning damage. They can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling (DC 22 Reflex save save).

text: Abyssal fire hits the stone beneath the ramp, causing a 15-foot-long section of it to collapse.
